guidance.summary: Targeting around INR 6,000 crore IT hardware revenue in FY27
guidance.speaker: Atul Lall
guidance.quote: This year itself we feel confident that we are going to be somewhere around INR 6,000 crores in this business.

guidance.summary: Targeting INR 15,000 to 20,000 crore IT hardware revenue in next couple years
guidance.speaker: Atul Lall
guidance.quote: We feel that in next couple of years , this is going to be almost INR 15,000 crore to INR 20,000 crore business for us.

guidance.summary: Targeting INR 6,000 to 6,500 crore IT hardware revenue in FY27
guidance.speaker: Saurabh Gupta
guidance.quote: Yes, so basically, just to add, Renu, this year we are looking at a volume of closer to 1.3 -1.4 million, which will translate into revenues of closer to INR 6,000-6,500 crores.

guidance.summary: Targeting Q Tech revenue of INR 2,500 to 3,000 crores in FY28
guidance.speaker: Saurabh Gupta
guidance.quote: Now as far as Q Tech is concerned, of course, you have to make budgets for next year, but broadly we should be in a kind of a number of almost somewhere between INR 2,500 crores to INR 3,000 odd crores.

guidance.summary: Targeting display business potential revenue of INR 6,000 to 7,000 crores
guidance.speaker: Saurabh Gupta
guidance.quote: So the real potential for display business, once it is completely ramped up in next couple of years, it can generate revenues of closer to INR 6,000 crores to INR 7,000 crores.

guidance.summary: Targeting total capex of INR 1,200 crores for FY27
guidance.speaker: Saurabh Gupta
guidance.quote: INR 700-odd crores is what we have done in first 6 months, and we will likely to do closer to INR 500 crores. So we should close the year with INR 1,200 crores.

guidance.summary: Targeting capex of INR 1,200 to 1,300 crores in FY28
guidance.speaker: Saurabh Gupta
guidance.quote: Of course, one has to do the numbers for next year, but broadly that should be the run rate for next year financial year as well, somewhere between INR 1,200-1,300 odd crores.
